description: The file defines the 'Worksheet' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for writing worksheet data into the Excel BIFF (.xls) format. It includes methods for writing sheet properties, cell data, formatting, protections, hyperlinks, and other sheet features, acting as a core component for generating Excel files in the PHPExcel/PhpSpreadsheet suite.

classes.name: Worksheet
classes.description: Represents a worksheet in an Excel BIFF (.xls) file, providing methods to write worksheet data, properties, formatting, protections, hyperlinks, and other features into the binary BIFF format.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes writing the worksheet to the BIFF file, including sheet properties, cell data, protections, hyperlinks, and other sheet-specific records.

methods.name: writeConditionalFormatting
methods.description: Writes conditional formatting rules and styles to the worksheet.

methods.name: writeBIFF8CellRangeAddressFixed
methods.description: Encodes a cell range address in BIFF8 fixed format.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the accumulated binary data of the worksheet.

methods.name: printRowColHeaders
methods.description: Sets whether to print row and column headers on printouts.

methods.name: setOutline
methods.description: Configures outline and grouping properties for the worksheet.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Writes a numeric cell value at specified row and column.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string cell value.

methods.name: writeRichTextString
methods.description: Writes a rich text string cell value, with formatting.

methods.name: writeLabelSst
methods.description: Writes a shared string table reference for a string cell.

methods.name: writeBlank
methods.description: Writes a blank cell with optional formatting.

methods.name: writeBoolErr
methods.description: Writes a boolean or error cell.

methods.name: writeFormula
methods.description: Writes a formula cell at the specified location.

methods.name: writeStringRecord
methods.description: Writes a string record used for formulas with string results.

methods.name: writeUrl
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink to a cell.

methods.name: writeUrlRange
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink to a range of cells.

methods.name: writeUrlWeb
methods.description: Writes a web URL hyperlink.

methods.name: writeUrlInternal
methods.description: Writes an internal sheet reference hyperlink.

methods.name: writeUrlExternal
methods.description: Writes an external file or directory hyperlink.

methods.name: writeRow
methods.description: Defines row height and style.

methods.name: writeDimensions
methods.description: Defines the sheet data area.

methods.name: writeWindow2
methods.description: Writes window display properties.

methods.name: writeDefaultRowHeight
methods.description: Sets default row height.

methods.name: writeDefcol
methods.description: Defines default column width.

methods.name: writeColinfo
methods.description: Defines column width and style.

methods.name: writeSelection
methods.description: Defines which cells are selected.

methods.name: writeMergedCells
methods.description: Defines merged cell ranges.

methods.name: writeSheetLayout
methods.description: Sets tab color for the sheet.

methods.name: protectionBitsDefaultFalse
methods.description: Calculates protection bits assuming default false value.

methods.name: protectionBitsDefaultTrue
methods.description: Calculates protection bits assuming default true value.

methods.name: writeSheetProtection
methods.description: Writes sheet protection options.

methods.name: writeRangeProtection
methods.description: Writes protection for specific cell ranges.

methods.name: writePanes
methods.description: Defines frozen or thawed panes.

methods.name: writeSetup
methods.description: Writes print setup and page layout properties.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Writes the sheet header caption.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Writes the sheet footer caption.

methods.name: writeHcenter
methods.description: Writes horizontal page centering option.

methods.name: writeVcenter
methods.description: Writes vertical page centering option.

methods.name: writeMarginLeft
methods.description: Writes left page margin.

methods.name: writeMarginRight
methods.description: Writes right page margin.

methods.name: writeMarginTop
methods.description: Writes top page margin.

methods.name: writeMarginBottom
methods.description: Writes bottom page margin.

methods.name: writePrintHeaders
methods.description: Configures whether to print sheet headers.

methods.name: writePrintGridlines
methods.description: Configures whether to print gridlines.

methods.name: writeGridset
methods.description: Defines whether gridlines are printed.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterInfo
methods.description: Writes auto-filter information.

methods.name: writeGridset
methods.description: Writes the GRIDSET BIFF record used in conjunction with PRINTGRIDLINES.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterInfo
methods.description: Writes the AUTOFILTERINFO BIFF record to configure autofilter settings.

methods.name: writeGuts
methods.description: Writes the GUTS BIFF record, configuring outline gutter margins.

methods.name: writeWsbool
methods.description: Writes the WSBOOL BIFF record, mainly for fit-to-page options.

methods.name: writeBreaks
methods.description: Writes the HORIZONTALPAGEBREAKS and VERTICALPAGEBREAKS BIFF records for page breaks.

methods.name: writeProtect
methods.description: Sets the worksheet protection status.

methods.name: writeScenProtect
methods.description: Sets sheet scenario protection.

methods.name: writeObjectProtect
methods.description: Sets object protection on the sheet.

methods.name: writePassword
methods.description: Writes the PASSWORD BIFF record for sheet protection.

methods.name: insertBitmap
methods.description: Inserts a bitmap image into the worksheet at specified cell location with optional offsets and scaling.

methods.name: positionImage
methods.description: Calculates and sets the vertices for an image based on cell positions, scaling, and offsets.

methods.name: writeObjPicture
methods.description: Stores the OBJ record that precedes image data, defining position and appearance.

methods.name: processBitmapGd
methods.description: Converts a GD image resource into internal bitmap format for XLS embedding.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Converts a BMP file into internal bitmap format for XLS embedding, validating BMP headers and data.

methods.name: writeZoom
methods.description: Stores the window zoom factor for the worksheet view.

methods.name: getEscher
methods.description: Returns the Escher object used for drawing shapes and images.

methods.name: setEscher
methods.description: Assigns an Escher object for drawing objects.

methods.name: writeMsoDrawing
methods.description: Writes MSODRAWING and OBJ records for embedded drawings or images using Escher graphics.

methods.name: writeDataValidity
methods.description: Stores data validation rules and dropdown options in the worksheet.

methods.name: writeCFRule
methods.description: Writes a conditional formatting rule based on specified conditions.

methods.name: writeCFHeader
methods.description: Stores the CFHEADER record for conditional formatting over a cell range.

methods.name: getDataBlockProtection
methods.description: Returns protection-related bits based on cell protection styles for conditional formatting.
